order: First verify article identity, linked panel and whether the graph is consecutive GCD retention or selected CV/GCD snapshots. Extract only bounded test identity, reported configuration, protocol and cycle horizon; do not emit text or values that identify target outcomes. If plot meaning can support early inputs, locate external axes without exposing plot interior, then verify early windows under the Phase 46 gate. If no eligible graph, hold the case and preserve its sealed figures.
leakage_guard: Do not display original images, titles with outcomes, body passages, full-area intermediate coordinates, terminal values or figures. Mask before any trace inspection, enforce both windows and late-pixel isolation. Record any actual leak and transfer entire article to development if it occurs.
admission: At least three independent positive observations in the chosen window, known same-test sample, method, current and initial reference, and prior-source/family audit. Keep 2E/3E separate. No new fits, prediction locks, outcome reveal or final independent admission in this round.
